The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Changes organized to organised and notes that 03/04/26 is ambiguous and should be written in words as 3 April 2026 if that is the meaning
- Keeps whānau with its macron and does not italicise it or add an s
- Treats program versus programme as a usage point and says it is not confirmed from a fetched style guide
